name: U.S. Bank Business Altitude® Connect Visa Signature® Card

welcome_offer.description: Earn 75,000 bonus points after eligible net purchases totaling $6,000 or more within 180 days of account opening. $0 intro annual fee for the first year, $95 per year thereafter.

earning_rates.notes: 5X on hotels and car rentals booked directly in the U.S. Bank Travel Center
4X on travel including airfare, hotels, gas and EV charging stations on the first $150,000 in combined annual spend (excludes discount stores/supercenters and wholesale clubs)
2X on dining, takeout, restaurant delivery and cell phone services

other_benefits.name: Cell phone protection
other_benefits.description: Up to $600 coverage for stolen/damaged cell phones

sources.notes: Official U.S. Bank page checked 2026-10-02: 75,000 bonus points after $6,000 in 180 days; $0 intro annual fee first year, then $95; 5X/4X/2X/1X earning.

notes: Annual fee waived first year. $25 ride-share credit after 3 consecutive monthly rides. Strong for gas and cellular spend.
